ai_summary_zh: 本場區為鋪面道路與人行步道環境，總面積約700.8平方公尺，鋪面狀況良好。場區內共有126株喬木，平均胸徑(DBH)為22.0公分，並包含115.6平方公尺的擋土牆與建築牆面結構。場區內無水域。
ai_summary_en: The site consists of paved roads and walkways covering approximately 700.8 square meters in good condition. There are 126 urban/park trees with a mean DBH of 22.0 cm at 1.3m, alongside 115.6 square meters of retaining and building wall structures. There are no water bodies on site.
